title: Easy Spring Indian Chickpeas Chana Masala
description: A peppery and springy Indian dish featuring braeburn apples and a wood-fired bake, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit for wood-fired baking.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced braeburn apples and cook for 2 minutes until they start to soften.
Stir in the garam masala, cumin, and turmeric and cook for 1 minute until the spices are fragrant.
Add the chickpeas, tomato puree, and salt to taste, and stir well to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes until the flavors have melded together.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot over basmati rice or with naan bread.
